user_query: My friend is a cat lover and wants to adopt a new cat. Can you provide me with a list of all available cat breeds using the Cat Breeds API? Also, fetch the breed information for the 'aegean' cat breed. Additionally, I would like to search for cat-related products on Amazon using the Amazon Web Scraping API, with the search term 'cat toys'.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of all available cat breeds from the Cat Breeds API.
Fetch the breed information for the 'aegean' cat breed from the Cat Breeds API. (This depends on the completion of Subtask 1 to ensure 'aegean' is an available breed.)
Search for cat-related products using the Amazon Web Scraping API with the search term 'cat toys'.
